keep.text: Aap logon ko pata hai kya ki Indians
ke pet pe itni saari charbi hoti kaise hai?
Bahar se ekdam patla aur andar se ekdam mota.
Saare logon ki skin dekhi hogi, haath ekdam patle dikhenge, pair ekdam patle dikhenge, pet ekdam bada dikhega.
Aur aisa hota kyun hai, main batata hoon.
Iska jawab hai British Raj.
Bengal famine in 1770,
Madras famine
1877, angrezon ne hamara khana chheena.
Karodon log bhookhe mare.
Generations tak bhookhe rahe.
Jab generations tak body ko khana nahi mila,
toh body ne adapt kiya.
DNA level pe change aaya.
Aur
isko science kehti hai thrifty gene mutation.
Aur ye thrifty genes kya hai? Thrifty genes
body mein ek storer bana deti hai. Matlab jo bhi khana mile,
usse zyada se zyada fat mein convert karo
aur store kar lo,
kyunki kal agar khana nahi mila toh phir kya karenge?
Aur ye 200 saal pehle survival tha, aur aaj ke time par disease ban gaya hai.
Kyunki aaj ke khaane mein
kami nahi hai, surplus hai. Zomato, Swiggy,
fridge mein jo bhi bhara pada rehta hai, saari cheezein. Aap logon ko toh apna pet kooda-daan lagta hai,
toh aap saari cheezein usmein bhar dete ho.
Par body abhi bhi
store usi tareeke se kar rahi hai jaise pehle karti thi.
Genes abhi bhi waise kaam kar rahe hain jaise pehle karte the.
Aur isi liye Indians ka phenotype hai
TOFI, yaani ki thin outside
fat inside.
Bahar se patla dikhta hai,
par andar visceral fat ekdam bhara hua hai.
Zyada insulin resistance ho gaya hai, zyada diabetes risk hai, zyada heart risk hai.
Aur in saari cheezon ka proof pata hai kya hai? Indians jo America mein bhi reh rahe hain, wahi khaana kha rahe hain jo whites kha rahe hain,
white Americans kha rahe hain,
same lifestyle hai, same saari cheezein, phir bhi unhe diabetes aur heart diseases zyada hoti hain in comparison to aur saare logon se.
Kyunki genes change ho chuke hain poore ke poore generation mein.
Par genetics is not a sentence, ye ek predisposition hai.
Matlab
gun loaded hai,
trigger aap kheenchte ho
apni lifestyle se.
Genetics 30%,
lifestyle 70% aapki
usko control karti hai.
Par Indian body ke liye special protocol chahiye,
ek system chahiye.
Western diet plans Indians pe kaam nahi karte hain, kyunki hamari body differently programmed hai.
Aur main saari cheezein
ek achhe se system mein bana chuka hoon. Agar aap logon ko ye system chahiye,
toh comment box mein likh do HEALTH,
aap logon ke paas link pahunch jaayega.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana. You are watching FitFinfluencer.
Milte hain
next video mein!
